name: SevenNet (Scalable EquiVariance-Enabled Neural Network)
subcategory: universal interatomic potentials with parallel MD
origin_detail: MDIL-SNU GitHub organisation (Seungwu Han is a co-author on the cited papers). The Seoul National University affiliation is implied by the org name but not stated on fetched pages.

licences.weights: distributed via repo/figshare; separate licence not stated
licences.data: trained on open datasets (MPtrj, sAlex, OMat24; Omni on 15 open ab initio datasets)

openness_notes: The LICENSE created on 2023-06-28 was GPL-3.0; commit 44ab70f, 'license to mit', switched it to MIT on 2025-06-20 (a further edit on 2026-04-07 has an unclear message). Pretrained models: SevenNet-0 and l3i5 (MPtrj), omat (OMat24), MF-ompa (MPtrj, sAlex, OMat24; figshare download), Omni ('15 open ab initio datasets'), Nano (distilled from Omni). The docs give no weights licence. Group I scoring: 0 = no weights; 1 = weights only under non-commercial or gated custom terms; 2 = open code/weights with the flagship model, weights or training data closed (open core); 3 = code and weights under OSI-type or CC BY licences; 4 = 3 plus openly downloadable training data, or outputs published as an open database stewarded by a public institution. Score 4 throughout (GPL-3.0 is OSI-approved; training data public); the 2025 change made it permissive.

relicensing_events.outcome_note: Removes copyleft obligations for commercial integrators; the opposite direction to MACE's later ASL models.

robustness: Permissive code since 2025; models trained on public data.
physical_science_relevance: Large-scale parallel MD with universal potentials (multi-fidelity training across DFT levels).

training_data.name: 15 open ab initio datasets
training_data.note: SevenNet-Omni; task names suggest OMol25, MatPES, SPICE (not confirmed).

openness_effect_assessment: A Korean academic group moved from copyleft to permissive licensing to widen reuse, which shows licence direction in academic MLIPs is mixed (SevenNet opened while MACE partly closed).
key_takeaway: Academic MLIP licences are converging on permissive terms, but not uniformly. Check the licence of each checkpoint, not only the code.
